A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|New Sith Order]], this '''[[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was part of a group that attacked [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] during the execution of [[Operation: Thunderstroke]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. He fought against [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]] but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the process.<ref name="Legacy 2006 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>
